items.text: Kansas City (Wednesday): Patrick Mahomes (knee) was full; CB L'Jarius Sneed (personal/knee) did not practice; WR Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) and LB Nick Bolton (neck) were limited. LT Josh Simmons is on IR.

Denver (Wednesday): WR Jaylen Waddle (chest), DL Zach Allen (hamstring) and S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) did not practice; CB Pat Surtain II (ankle) was a full participant; OT Garett Bolles (hip) and WR Marvin Mims Jr. (ankle) were limited. Waddle is TBD, expected questionable.
